tools.description: Search Bolot Studio FAQs and store policies. Covers product questions, sizing, finishes, shipping, returns, and ordering.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, get_store_info, get_reviews_summary · Public sink: check_photo_compatibility, check_photo_compatibility_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, get_store_info, get_reviews_summary · Public sink: check_photo_compatibility, check_photo_compatibility_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
